category_title: Low-achieving students in inclusive settings who exhibit superficial responses or off-task behavior when objectives are unclear
minimal_context: The student is working on an anticipation-reaction guide and examining photographs and resource maps of different countries in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, look at your anticipation-reaction guides. For each statement, you need to check 'Agree' or 'Disagree' based on the photographs and resource maps.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Are we supposed to write that down? We don't have nothin' in the box right here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, if you need to write something, write it on the back. Let's look at the pictures of the countries.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: We have a lot of stuff in this one. That one's clean. The other ones, they're wiggity-wack. Jobs don't pay as much.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, look at number 2 on your guide.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: So, what is it? We don't know. It's like court. (The student mouths and pantomimes a debate)
